source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
An **attached unit** is several units acting as one. This chapter covers:

- [how they form](vsdata:core-rule/forming-attached-units)
- [how attacks against them resolve](vsdata:core-rule/attacking-attached-units)
- how their [keywords](vsdata:core-rule/keywords-in-attached-units) and [abilities](vsdata:core-rule/abilities-in-attached-units) work
